supports.excerpt:
### Preferred Communication Channels

1. **GitHub Issues & Discussions**:
   - Open an [issue](https://github.com/AgentOps-AI/agentops/issues) for:
     - Bug reports
     - Feature requests
     - Documentation improvements
   - Start a [discussion](https://github.com/AgentOps-AI/agentops/discussions) for:
     - Questions about usage
     - Ideas for new features
     - Community showcase
     - General feedback

2. **Discord Community**:
   - Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/FagdcwwXRR) for:
     - Real-time help
     - Community discussions
     - Feature announcements
     - Sharing your projects

3. **Contact Form**:
   - For private inquiries, use our [contact form](https://agentops.ai/contact)
   - Please note that public channels are preferred for technical discussions

## License

skill_drafts.name: Route Communication Channel by Issue Type
skill_drafts.description: Determine and direct user inquiries to the appropriate communication channel (GitHub Issues, GitHub Discussions, Discord, or contact form) based on issue category and urgency.
skill_drafts.objective: Route incoming user requests to correct support channel
applicable_signals: Request contains error logs or reproduction steps (bug signal)
Request proposes new capability or enhancement (feature signal)
Request asks how to use existing functionality (usage signal)
Request is general comment or suggestion (feedback signal)
Request contains sensitive or private information (privacy signal)
contraindications: Issue is already assigned to a channel
User explicitly specifies preferred contact method
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Classify request type', 'detail': 'Identify whether incoming request is bug report, feature request, usage question, general feedback, or private inquiry'}

{'step': 2, 'action': 'Match to channel', 'detail': 'Map classification to channel: GitHub Issues (bugs, feature requests); GitHub Discussions (usage, ideas, showcase, feedback); Discord (real-time help, community); Contact Form (private)'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Prepare forwarding', 'detail': 'Preserve full request context, user information, and any attachments or code samples'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Route to channel', 'detail': 'Submit request to selected channel with appropriate formatting and metadata'}
triggers: Support team receives incoming request requiring triage
constraints: Public channels are preferred for technical discussions
Private inquiries must use contact form
All forwarded requests must include original context and user identifier
cautions: Ensure sensitive information in private inquiries is not posted to public channels
Verify channel-specific formatting requirements before forwarding
Maintain audit trail of routing decisions for support analytics
output_contract: User request successfully forwarded to correct channel with full context preserved. Confirmation that GitHub issue or discussion was created, Discord message was posted, or contact form was submitted. User receives acknowledgment and expected response timeline for selected channel.

metadata.prompt: Classify the incoming user request by type (bug report, feature request, usage question, general feedback, or private inquiry). Match the classification to the preferred channel: GitHub Issues for bugs and feature requests; GitHub Discussions for usage questions, feature ideas, community showcase, and general feedback; Discord for real-time help and community discussions; contact form for private inquiries. Forward the request with full context to the selected channel.

skill_drafts.name: Escalate Private Inquiries via Contact Form
skill_drafts.description: Route sensitive or private user inquiries through the contact form instead of public channels to maintain confidentiality and prevent exposure of sensitive business information or personal data.
skill_drafts.objective: Protect user privacy by preventing sensitive information from being posted in public channels
applicable_signals: User inquiry contains sensitive business information
User explicitly requests private or confidential communication
User indicates need for non-public handling
contraindications: Issue is a public bug report or feature request
User explicitly requests public discussion or community visibility
Inquiry is a technical documentation question
Issue is a feature announcement or community showcase
intervention_moves: Identify sensitivity markers in incoming inquiry
Offer contact form link with explanation of privacy protection
Confirm user understands public vs. private channel distinction
triggers: User inquiry contains sensitive business information, personal data, or requires confidential handling; user requests private communication
constraints: Public channels (GitHub Issues, Discussions, Discord) must remain free of sensitive data
Contact form must be presented as the exclusive channel for private inquiries
Technical discussions should be directed to public channels when no confidentiality is required
cautions: Do not assume all inquiries are sensitive; only escalate when explicit indicators are present
Ensure contact form link is functional and accessible before directing users
output_contract: Private inquiry successfully redirected to contact form; confirmation that public channels remain free of sensitive data; user receives clear guidance on confidential submission process

metadata.prompt: When a user inquiry contains sensitive business information, personal data, or explicitly requests confidential handling, direct the user to submit via the contact form rather than GitHub Issues, Discussions, or Discord. Emphasize that public channels are preferred for technical discussions only.
